coverage_status: Partial shared scalar/NumPy components plus policy-selected native/vector input adaptation. Native scalar source has source-AST differential tests for covered fragments. NumPy score components still lack a complete ordered ASR array composer and v12 action consumer; account/tracker, registry, gate/return, and time-state inputs remain unresolved.
current_asr_mutation_semantics: Count includes initialization plus direct score assignment/augmented-assignment statements still inside rate(); shared scalar hooks remove corresponding inline statements. It is a source mutation census, not the uncovered-component count.
existing_vector_related_modules: vec_paths/live_entry_engine.py (separate LIVE_ENTRY_ENGINE score, not AdvancedSignalRater aggregate)

input_policy_adapter.policy: Per-symbol USE_1M_3M_SIGNALS_ENABLED. OFF pairs raw 1m/3m/5m fields and 3m event cache with actual 15m peers when present; higher TFs preserved. ON preserves micro values and reports required missing fields. Input mappings are copied. NumPy ASR component adapters use paired_npz_view.

non_npz_score_inputs: top_sent/bot_sent and rank data from cross-symbol registry
delta active-time state and reentry markers
early-return MTS/HTF/regime/eligibility gates and tracker state
